title: VK-only Read File Record nested single-subrequest parser walk
purpose: Reach a deeper parser structure with one coherent file-record subrequest, using conservative nested lengths to exercise record parsing paths related to prior crash reports involving mixed multi-message and complex request structures.
expected_behavior: A compliant implementation should parse the nested byte-count and subrequest descriptor consistently, then either service or reject the file/record access without overrunning internal buffers.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 000a matches unit identifier plus 9-byte PDU
Nested request byte count 07 matches one 7-byte subrequest
issue_safety_notes: The frame is a conservative structural analogue and not a copy of any reported PoC; it intentionally uses a single coherent subrequest to focus on parser depth rather than overt corruption.
